convert_opencv_to_pytorch3d_cameras: convert OpenCV camera projection parameters R, tvec, and camera_matrix into a PyTorch3D PerspectiveCameras object
convert_pytorch3d_cameras_to_opencv: convert a PyTorch3D PerspectiveCameras object back into OpenCV R, tvec, and camera_matrix tensors
convert_opencv_to_pulsar_params: convert OpenCV camera projection parameters into Pulsar camera parameters tensor with position, rotation, and intrinsics
convert_pytorch3d_cameras_to_pulsar: convert a PyTorch3D PerspectiveCameras object into Pulsar camera parameters by first converting to OpenCV format
review_camera_conversions_module: review the camera_conversions module functions for converting between OpenCV, PyTorch3D, and Pulsar camera representations
